description.text: The third round of Pokémon TCG Gym promos, from the 2026 Present Pack given out in Malaysia, the Philippines and Singapore. Pokémon TCG Asia announced the new round for Gym shops from 1 June 2026. Gym shops give these promos out as participation prizes, while stocks last. Each is an English card reprinted with the Pokémon TCG Gym stamp, keeping its original's number. This round reprints cards of the Mega Evolution base set, such as Cinderace, Hariyama, Lunatone and Solrock, Lillie's Determination and Wally's Compassion, with cards of late Scarlet & Violet sets such as Ethan's Ho-Oh ex, Lillie's Clefairy ex and Genesect ex.
